title: Quote a 10-parcel shipment in under 300 ms at p95

fields.summary: As a partner shop at checkout, I want POST /quotes to return a quote within 300 ms at p95, so that my customers are not kept waiting.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [metric] state: a local server with the seeded rate table, one warm-up request, then a one-minute load test sending POST /quotes with 10 parcels at 20 requests a second; expected: p95 response time under 300 ms
2. [api-trace] state: POST /quotes with the seeded parcels in test/quotes.test.js, before and after the change; expected: the same amount in pence on every line and the same total_pence
fields.measure: p95 response time of POST /quotes in the load test
fields.threshold: under 300 ms at 20 requests a second with 10 parcels
fields.scenario: Start the server locally with the seeded rate table, send one warm-up request, run the one-minute load test against POST /quotes, and compare the seeded parcels' quotes with today's.
fields.environment: a local server on linux with the seeded synthetic rate table; never a partner's traffic
fields.checkpoints:
1. The one-minute load test reports p95 for POST /quotes under 300 ms (criterion 1)
2. Quotes for the seeded parcels match today's amounts (criterion 2)
fields.assumptions:
- Measured after one warm-up request on a local server (the accepted default).
- The seeded rate table stands for the real one.
fields.open_questions: - answered: whether GET /quotes/{id} changes (no: only POST /quotes)
fields.parked_ideas:
- CI budget: a k6 threshold in CI (raised by grill; the human parked it)
- loading feedback: partners show their own spinner (the human parked it)
fields.provenance:
Request: "The quotes API is too slow at checkout. Make it fast. It belongs under Feature #80 (Partner integrations)."
Vague: "slow" → criteria 1
Vague: "fast" → criteria 1
1. confirmed (perf.target/percentile-and-number): "p95 under 300 ms for a quote of 10 parcels" / "About 20 quotes a second at peak" / "A one-minute load test against a local server with the seeded rate table" / "Your default is fine."; facts: route:/quotes, gap:api-budget
2. confirmed (request/existing-behaviour): "The amounts must stay exactly the same; only the speed changes."; facts: route:/quotes, code:src/routes/quotes.js
